# JYG Garment

> JYG Garment is a custom apparel manufacturer based in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It produces made-to-order garments for emerging fashion brands worldwide with a standard MOQ of 100 pieces per style, a 20-day lead time and a free design service.

## Key facts

- Business name: JYG Garment
- Business type: Custom apparel manufacturer (OEM / ODM custom garment production, private label)
- Location: 101, Building A28, Huifu Industrial Park, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- Email: jyggarment@foxmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 13922181466
- Minimum order quantity: 100 pieces per style
- Standard lead time: 20 days from sample approval
- Facility: 5,000 sqm, 10+ production lines, 100+ skilled garment workers
- Annual capacity: 200,000 units
- Experience: 15+ years; third-generation garment merchant family with roots in 1973 (grandfather's shop) and Ming Lang Ge (MLG) established by the father in 1998. The international branch JYG began in 2025.
- Clients served: 2,000+ brands across 50+ countries
- Design service: free (tech pack work, size chart, pattern making)
- Shipping: 50+ countries
- Industries: t-shirts, hoodies and sweatshirts, jackets, snap shirts, private label apparel

## Product range

- T-shirts: Boxy Tee, Cropped Boxy Tee, Oversized Boxy Tee, Slim-fit Boxy Tee, Drop-Shoulder SS Tee, Layered Sleeve Tee, Oversized Long-Sleeve Tee, Sleeveless Boxy Tee
- Hoodies and sweats: Basic Full-Zip Hoodie, Minimalist Full-Zip Hoodie, Curved Seam Panel Zip Hoodie, Pullover Hoodie, Cropped Hoodie
- Jackets and shirting: Contrast Piping Mock Neck Jacket, Retro Track Jacket, Baseball Snap Shirt

## Manufacturing process (10 stages)

1. Consulting - style / previous work sharing, tech pack, fabric and techniques
2. Documentation - pre-production file
3. Sampling Terms - sample cost, estimated bulk price, timeline, payment link
4. Patterning - size chart and pattern making
5. Sample Making - fabric and trim sourcing, secondary processes, sewing, shipping
6. Sample Evaluation - buyer review, revision and approval
7. Quotation - unit pricing, customized accessories, deposit
8. Sourcing - raw material sourcing and trim customization, mold making
9. Grading - size grading and final specs verification
10. Fulfillment - bulk production, QC inspection, packaging, remaining payment, shipping
